insurer.name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.source_excerpt: Room rent is limited to Rs. 5,000 per day or actuals, whichever is lower.

icu_rent.source_excerpt: ICU charges are limited to 2% of the sum insured per day.

co_pay.source_excerpt: A co-payment of 10% shall apply to every admissible claim under this policy.

sub_limits.source_excerpt: Road Ambulance Charges Rs. 2,000 Per hospitalisation

waiting_periods.source_excerpt: 30 days from the date of commencement of the first policy, except in case of accidental injury.
Pre-existing diseases shall be covered after 36 months of continuous coverage with the Company.

waiting_periods.label: Hernia, cataract, joint replacement
waiting_periods.source_excerpt: A waiting period of 24 months applies to the following, when the condition is not pre-existing:
Maternity expenses are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

exclusions.text: Cosmetic and aesthetic treatment of any description
Dental treatment, unless arising out of an accident
Expenses arising from war, invasion, act of foreign enemy, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, or nuclear perils
Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse
Expenses for spectacles, contact lenses and hearing aids
Any treatment received in convalescent homes, rest homes, health hydros, nature cure clinics
Sterility, infertility and assisted conception procedures
Vitamins and tonics unless forming part of treatment
Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest, diagnostics or evaluation
Participation in hazardous or adventure sports
Breach of law with criminal intent

proportionate_deduction.note: Applies when the chosen room rate exceeds room_rent.resolved_per_day.
